item.title: CVE-2026-58249 SAP netweaver: SAP NetWeaver and SAP Web Dispatcher do not properly validate certain fields in specially crafted requests...
item.description: SAP NetWeaver and SAP Web Dispatcher do not properly validate certain fields in specially crafted requests handled by an internal protocol component. An unauthenticated attacker could send a malicious request that triggers a memory-handling error, causing the affected process to crash. Successful exploitation can therefore result in a high impact on the availability of the affected application. There is no impact on the confidentiality or integrity of the application. | CVSS 7.5 | EPSS 0.4%

item.title: CVE-2026-89107 SAP s/4hana: SAP S/4HANA (Manage Substitution/Validation Rules) does not sufficiently validate input processed by rule...
item.description: SAP S/4HANA (Manage Substitution/Validation Rules) does not sufficiently validate input processed by rule definition functionality that utilizes a domain-specific scripting language. An authenticated attacker with specific business privileges could submit specially crafted input, which is interpreted as executable ABAP code by the rule processing logic. Successful exploitation could allow the attacker to execute ABAP arbitrary code into the system, resulting in full compromise of the affected system and high impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the system. | CVSS 9.9 | EPSS 0.5%

item.title: CVE-2026-89108 SAP manufacturing integration and intelligence: SAP Manufacturing Integration and Intelligence does not sufficiently enforce authorization boundaries within...
item.description: SAP Manufacturing Integration and Intelligence does not sufficiently enforce authorization boundaries within certain administrative functionality. An attacker with MII administrator privileges could submit a specially crafted request to provision an account with elevated privileges on the underlying Java application server. Successful exploitation could allow the attacker to gain administrative control over the underlying system, extending the impact beyond the vulnerable application. This results in a high impact on confidentiality, integrity and availability. | CVSS 9.1 | EPSS 0.4%

item.title: CVE-2026-89110 SAP netweaver: SAP NetWeaver Visual Composer does not perform sufficient authorization checks in certain portal...
item.description: SAP NetWeaver Visual Composer does not perform sufficient authorization checks in certain portal functionality. An attacker with low privileges could invoke internal operations on a preconfigured remote system. Depending on the remote connection configuration, this could lead to a full compromise of the remote system. This results in a high impact on confidentiality, integrity and availability. | CVSS 9.9 | EPSS 0.4%

item.title: CVE-2026-89113 SAP commerce: SAP Commerce Cloud does not sufficiently validate certain user-supplied input before it is incorporated into...
item.description: SAP Commerce Cloud does not sufficiently validate certain user-supplied input before it is incorporated into a database query. An authenticated user could send specially crafted requests to affected functionality to inject arbitrary SQL commands. Successful exploitation could allow the user to read, modify or delete sensitive data from the application's database, resulting in a high impact on confidentiality, integrity and availability of the application. | CVSS 8.8 | EPSS 0.4%

item.title: CVE-2026-58240 SAP netweaver: SAP NetWeaver Message Server does not sufficiently validate the authenticity of internal application server...
item.description: SAP NetWeaver Message Server does not sufficiently validate the authenticity of internal application server components during registration. An unauthenticated attacker with network access to the affected service could exploit this weakness to register an unauthorized component and potentially perform unauthorized actions within the application environment, resulting in a high impact on the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the affected system. | CVSS 9.8 | EPSS 0.5%

item.title: CVE-2026-66767 SAP netweaver: SAP NetWeaver Application Server for ABAP and ABAP Platform allows an unauthenticated user to send a...
item.description: SAP NetWeaver Application Server for ABAP and ABAP Platform allows an unauthenticated user to send a specially crafted packet that triggers reprocessing of a previously buffered user request, potentially hijacking another user's session under narrow timing conditions. Successful exploitation could result in high impact on confidentiality and integrity, with low impact on availability of the application. | CVSS 7.7 | EPSS 0.4%

item.title: CVE-2026-66768 SAP gui: SAP GUI for Java does not correctly enforce the trust level policy for certain functions invoked from a...
item.description: SAP GUI for Java does not correctly enforce the trust level policy for certain functions invoked from a connected backend system. A low-privileged attacker could exploit this weakness by manipulating a connected backend system to trigger affected functionality. This could allow arbitrary command execution on the victim's machine, leading to a high impact on the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the affected system. | CVSS 9 | EPSS 0.6%

item.title: CVE-2026-76958 SAP integration suite: SAP Integration Suite does not sufficiently validate XML documents accepted from untrusted sources in certain...
item.description: SAP Integration Suite does not sufficiently validate XML documents accepted from untrusted sources in certain internal components. An attacker with low privileges could submit specially crafted XML payloads containing malicious external entity declarations. Successful exploitation could allow the attacker to read sensitive file contents from the server and expose them through monitoring or logging output, resulting in a high impact on confidentiality. It could also lead to resource exhaustion, causing a low impact on availability. There is no impact on integrity. | CVSS 8.5 | EPSS 0.4%

item.title: CVE-2026-76967 SAP netweaver: SAP NetWeaver Business Client does not perform sufficient validation when processing certain locally stored...
item.description: SAP NetWeaver Business Client does not perform sufficient validation when processing certain locally stored data during application startup. An attacker with low privileges on the local system could replace this data with specially crafted content. When the application is next launched, the crafted content is processed and could lead to arbitrary code execution in the context of the user. This results in a high impact on confidentiality, integrity and availability of the application. | CVSS 7.8 | EPSS 0.4%
